Indian Oil to Begin Supplying Sustainable Aviation Fuel

Indian Oil Corporation (IOC) is set to commence commercial supply of sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) from its Panipat refinery. The company has received government approval to supply SAF for blending purposes, marking a step towards meeting aviation fuel targets.
